title: asset-fact
description: Origin: entity-graph U4. A ONE-WAY authoritative fact INGESTED from an external CMDB (NetBox) onto an entity. The CMDB is authority for EXTERNALLY-ASSIGNED attributes ONLY — predicate is restricted to {owner, criticality}; it can NEVER carry an OBSERVED predicate (ip/mac/hostname/role/ja4/certs/applications/listening_services come from telemetry, not a CMDB). Every fact carries provenance: source=netbox-cmdb, the entity it describes (entity_ref), and the sync instant (synced_at). Keyed by (tenant_id, entity_ref, predicate) — tenant isolation is a partition invariant.

entity_ref.description: The entity the fact describes — an IP or a stable asset_key.

predicate.description: EXTERNALLY-ASSIGNED attributes ONLY. A CMDB cannot assert an observed predicate.

authority.description: The CMDB is authoritative for this predicate (one-way ingest).
